2607.29491.title: DreamQAS: Learning a Decision-Useful World Model for VQE-Efficient Quantum Architecture Search
2607.29491.paper_summary: Reinforcement-learning-based quantum architecture search (RL-QAS) repeatedly optimizes a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) after extending a circuit, although circuit construction and action legality are deterministic and known. We introduce DreamQAS, a model-based RL framework that preserves these exact circuit dynamics and learns only the expensive post-VQE feedback. A recurrent randomized-prior ensemble predicts an oracle-free score relative to an empirical energy frontier and supports multi-step imagined policy learning over explicit legal circuits. Ranking-based activation, uncertainty-aware pessimism and truncation, and selective real-VQE verification form a reliability-controlled learning loop. Under a common 15,000-episode budget and frozen evaluation for the RL methods, DreamQAS has the lowest mean frozen-policy energy error on four of five molecular tasks and the second-lowest on one. At fine-error targets reached by all seeds of both methods, it uses 1.6x to 2.0x fewer real VQE calls on four tasks and 10.6x fewer on BeH2-8q. Counterfactual action-ranking utility increases across all five tasks, with a mean increase of 0.346 and a 95 percent confidence interval of [0.185, 0.507], while direct greedy and beam use of the same model does not recover the gains of imagined policy learning. Ensemble disagreement also improves risk-coverage over random rejection on all three probed tasks. These results establish a world-model design for QAS whose value lies in decision-useful feedback rather than exact energy prediction.
2607.29491.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習基礎的量子架構搜索（RL-QAS）在擴展電路後重複優化變分量子特徵求解器（VQE），儘管電路建構和行動合法性是確定且已知的。我們介紹了DreamQAS，一個基於模型的強化學習框架，保留這些精確的電路動態，並僅學習昂貴的後VQE反饋。一個重複隨機先驗集預測相對於經驗能量邊界的無神諭者分數，並支持在明確合法電路上進行多步想像策略學習。基於排名的激活、不確定性意識的悲觀和截斷，以及選擇性真實VQE驗證形成了一個可靠性控制的學習循環。在共同的15,000集預算和凍結評估的RL方法下，DreamQAS在五個分子任務中的四個上具有最低的平均凍結策略能量誤差，並在一個任務上排名第二。在所有種子都達到的精細誤差目標下，它在四個任務上使用的真實VQE調用數量比其他方法少1.6倍到2.0倍，在BeH2-8q上少10.6倍。反事實行動排名效用在所有五個任務中均有所增加，平均增幅為0.346，95%置信區間為[0.185, 0.507]，而直接貪婪和束搜索使用相同模型並未恢復想像策略學習的收益。集成不一致性也改善了在所有三個探測任務上隨機拒絕的風險覆蓋。這些結果確立了一個QAS的世界模型設計，其價值在於決策有用的反饋，而非精確的能量預測。
